# Analyzer

> Presentation-grade mutual fund research for India. Educational analytics only — not investment advice.

Analyzer helps investors and advisors review Indian mutual funds using rolling returns, Chance of Beating (COB) the benchmark, Sharpe Ratio, drawdowns, SIP matrices, and peer context.

## Important

- This product is not a SEBI-registered investment adviser or research analyst service.
- Past performance does not guarantee future results.
- Demo deployments use sample / captured fixtures and may not reflect live NAVs.
- Always verify figures with your AMC, RTA, or licensed adviser before acting.
